provenance.label: Hyperliquid mainnet perpetual 1m candles from the public info API (candleSnapshot, closed bars only); synchronized bbo and activeAssetCtx samples from a forward recording of the public WebSocket streams (receipt cutoff on a 60 s grid)

documents.quote: Perps fee tiers Base rate Diamond Platinum Gold Silver Bronze Wood Tier 14d weighted volume ($) Taker Maker Taker Maker Taker Maker Taker Maker Taker Maker Taker Maker Taker Maker 0 0.045% 0.015%
documents.supports: perps base-tier taker and maker fee

documents.quote: Order MinTradeNtl Order must have minimum value of $10.

Sizes are rounded to the szDecimals of that asset. For example, if szDecimals = 3 then 1.001 is a valid size but 1.0001 is not. szDecimals for an asset is found in the meta response to the info endpoint
type PerpsAssetCtx = SharedAssetCtx & { funding: number; openInterest: number; oraclePx: number; };
documents.supports: oracle source: activeAssetCtx carries PerpsAssetCtx.oraclePx and no event timestamp, so oracle freshness is receipt age only

documents.quote: There is no guarantee of timely updates and data may be missing.
documents.supports: historical asset contexts exist only in a requester-pays archive with possible gaps and no receipt times

test.role: held-out: scored once with the frozen selection

train.role: selection: the parameter grid and the frozen selection rule read only this window

baselines.eligibility: every arm is scored on the identical bars. The report also gives each baseline with its entries masked to bars where the candidate's premium inputs were valid, and the share of bars each arm could decide (baseline warm-up uses pre-window candles and funding, the candidate cannot)
baselines.funding_skew: funding_skew with funding_window 360 one-minute bars and its other registered defaults, reading the pinned funding series as a frozen entry input (manifest funding_entry_input, rate aligned backward to each bar open); funding is still charged once as a cost
baselines.mean_reversion_pro: price mean reversion with its registered default parameters

protocol.event_replay: candidate-local event_replay.py on the raw recorded bbo stream: an entry decided at bar close D fills at the first accepted bbo received at or after D + 1000 ms modeled latency, buys at the ask and sells at the bid, size floored to the venue lot (BTC 5, ETH 4 size decimals) and limited to the displayed size at that quote (any remainder fills on later quotes, each displayed quantity used once per arm), refused below the 10 USD venue minimum. Exits: time_stop at the close of the 30th held bar, or the ATR stop when a later bbo bid (long) or ask (short) crosses the stop, each filled at the first bbo at or after that time plus latency at the touch. Taker fee 0.045% per fill; no extra half-spread charge because the touch already holds the spread. Funding: each hourly settlement while open charges notional at the settlement-time mid times the pinned rate (long pays a positive rate). No maker fill is assumed.
protocol.selection_rule: On train only, candle model at cost x1: eligible grid points have every dataset scored and at least 10 train positions; pick max mean DD-adjusted return, then max mean Sharpe, then earliest grid order. No eligible point: the seed is used and the outcome is recorded. Parameter stability is the share of grid points with positive train net PnL.
protocol.sizing: full capital per position, unlevered; execution_spec models fees, spread, slippage, lot floor and the venue minimum; at 1x a liquidation cannot occur

verdict_criteria.fail: data sufficient and any pass check false
inconclusive_if_any: the recording is incomplete or damaged (not closed, a dropped record, an incomplete segment, or an independent replay mismatch)
fewer than 30 candidate positions across coins on test in the event replay
any coin's test window has fewer than 70% of its bars with valid premium inputs at their own decision time
verdict_criteria.live_status: production_refused regardless of the verdict; promotion needs a separate reviewed decision
pass_if_all: event-replay candidate test net PnL > 0 at cost x1 and at cost x2
candle-model candidate test net PnL > 0 at cost x1
candidate test mean DD-adjusted return (candle model, cost x1) > each baseline, masked and unmasked
no single coin carries more than 60% of the candidate's absolute event-replay test PnL
